The '''Alkharan Bandit Camp''' was a camp used by the criminal group known as the [[Alkhara Bandits]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was located in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], at a short distance of [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]].<ref name="SWG:JPRB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Reelo Baruk]] hired a spacer to kill ten Alkharan bandits in their camp because they had previously attacked merchants under the protection of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="SWG:JPRB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Alkharan Bandit Camp appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JPRB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Alkharan Bandit Camp was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Jabba's Theme Park|Jabba's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:JPRB" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
